description: This file defines the 'Subscriptions' interface for managing local subscription collections, including methods for counting topics, subscribing, unsubscribing, removing subscribers, creating snapshots, exporting data, and checking if empty.

classes.name: Subscriptions
classes.description: Interface for write operations on a collection of local subscriptions, parameterized by the type representing distributed data.

methods.name: countTopics
methods.description: Returns the total number of topics with active subscriptions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an actor subscribes to any topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Streams the actors subscribed to a specific topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an actor to a set of topics with an optional filter for message topics.

methods.name: subscribe (default method)
methods.description: Subscribes an actor to topics without a filter, defaulting to all messages.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes an actor from specified topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber and all its subscriptions.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable snapshot of the current subscription state.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports an approximation of subscription data for cluster broadcasting, with optional forced update.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no active topics/subscriptions.
